purpose: Background extraction for transparent PNG chat stickers

records.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: transparent PNG chat sticker
Input image: edit target; remove background only.
Primary request: Create a clean faithful cutout of this exact provided meme image on genuinely transparent background with alpha.
Subject: The complete existing Coomer meme head and visible neck, with the same scribbled brown hair and beard, black bloodshot eyes, and grin. Preserve white face, white neck, teeth, and all internal facial details.
Composition: Center the complete original visible subject with small transparent margins. Keep every original visible portion and do not crop further.
Constraints: Preserve exact face, expression, proportions, colors, linework, details, style and pose. Do not redraw, reinterpret, beautify or add content. Preserve opaque white areas inside the subject. Remove only external background including stray exterior specks or baked checkerboard. Clean soft antialiased alpha edges; no rectangular matte, no new sticker border, no shadow, no text, no objects.
records.concerns: ImageGen slightly smooths/reproduces linework; inspect bottom cut edge after sizing.

qa.method: Sharp flattened diagnostic preview on #664466 at up to 650px; visually inspected
qa.result: Opaque subject interiors retained; background transparent and clean; no material visible holes or fringe at sticker scale.
